title: SendReceiptRequest
description: Request for sending a sale receipt to a customer using one or more distribution methods

orderVersion.description: Which version of the order that should be used to generate a receipt

receiptLanguage.description: Desired language of the receipt. Currently only supporting 'nob' and 'eng'

serialNumber.description: The desired serial number for the receipt

copyReceipt.description: Set to true when the receipt is a copy.

Distribution.title: Distribution
Distribution.description: Request for sending a receipt to a customer using one or more distribution methods. Will only send email if both email and telephone are provided. To send sms, leave email as null.
